sources.quote: the built-in File History backup feature in Windows may stop working on some systems after installing the September 2026 security updates.
A bug in the Windows Sept patch Tuesday update may stop File History from working.

claims.statement: A bug in Microsoft's September 2026 Windows update can break the File History backup feature.

sources.quote: But a new optional update fixes it.

claims.statement: Microsoft released a new optional update that fixes the File History bug.

headline: Windows September update breaks File History; Microsoft ships a fix
summary: Microsoft's September 2026 security update introduced a bug that could stop Windows' File History backup feature from working. Microsoft later released a new optional update that fixes the issue.
